measure.evidenceText: Google Hotels identifies Waldorf Hotel Buenos Aires at Paraguay 450, Buenos Aires as a 3-star hotel. The result shows $31 nightly and $37 total for 1 night with taxes + fees, an explicit 2 Adults selector, and Standard Double options with 1 double bed. The returned booking evidence contains no explicit one-unit occupancy wording.
